ucs.title: [LLM] Scattered Spider help-desk-driven MFA/password reset followed by sign-in from new device (UNC3944 / Octo Tempest vishing chain)
ucs.description: Hunts the actor's documented #1 initial-access tradecraft: a help-desk or admin persona resets a target user's password, MFA method, or authentication phone in Entra ID, and that same target then successfully signs in from a previously-unseen / non-compliant device within 60 minutes. CISA AA23-320A, Microsoft (Octo Tempest), and Mandiant (UNC3944) all attribute this exact 'vish-the-help-desk → MFA reset → sign-in from attacker laptop' chain to Scattered Spider.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats `summariesonly`
    min(_time) as reset_time,
    values(All_Changes.user) as initiator,
    values(All_Changes.action) as reset_action,
    values(All_Changes.src) as initiator_src
  from datamodel=Change
  where All_Changes.change_type="AAA"
    AND All_Changes.action IN ("modified","updated","cleared")
    AND All_Changes.object_category="user"
  by All_Changes.dest_user
| rename "All_Changes.dest_user" as user
| where initiator!=user AND initiator!="system"
| join type=inner user [
    | tstats `summariesonly`
        min(_time) as signin_time,
        values(Authentication.src) as signin_src,
        values(Authentication.src_user_agent) as user_agent,
        values(Authentication.app) as app,
        values(Authentication.src_geo_country) as country
      from datamodel=Authentication
      where Authentication.action="success"
        AND Authentication.app IN ("o365","azuread","entra","office365")
      by Authentication.user
    | rename "Authentication.user" as user
  ]
| where signin_time>=reset_time AND signin_time<=(reset_time+3600)
| eval minutes_after_reset=round((signin_time-reset_time)/60, 1)
| where initiator_src!=signin_src
| table reset_time, signin_time, minutes_after_reset, user, initiator, reset_action, initiator_src, signin_src, country, user_agent, app
| sort 0 - signin_time
ucs.kql:
let LookbackHours = 72h;
let ResetActions = dynamic([
    "Reset user password.","Change user password.","Reset password (by admin).",
    "Set force change user password.","Update user.",
    "Update authentication phone.","Update StrongAuthenticationUserDetails.",
    "Disable Strong Authentication.","User registered security info."
  ]);
let MfaReset = CloudAppEvents
  | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
  | where Application in ("Office 365","Microsoft Entra ID","Azure Active Directory")
  | where ActionType in (ResetActions)
  | mv-expand ActivityObjects
  | extend Target = tostring(ActivityObjects.Name)
  | extend TargetType = tostring(ActivityObjects.Type)
  | where TargetType =~ "Account" and Target contains "@"
  | extend Initiator = tostring(AccountDisplayName)
  | where isnotempty(Initiator) and tolower(Initiator) != tolower(Target)
  | project ResetTime = Timestamp, Initiator, InitiatorAccountObjectId = AccountObjectId,
            InitiatorIP = IPAddress, TargetUpn = tolower(Target), ResetAction = ActionType;
AADSignInEventsBeta
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
| where ErrorCode == 0
| where IsInteractive == true
| extend TargetUpn = tolower(AccountUpn)
| join kind=inner MfaReset on TargetUpn
| where Timestamp between (ResetTime .. ResetTime + 60m)
| extend MinutesSinceReset = datetime_diff('minute', Timestamp, ResetTime)
| where IPAddress != InitiatorIP    // sign-in from a different IP than the help-desk that initiated the reset
| project ResetTime, SigninTime = Timestamp, MinutesSinceReset,
          TargetUpn, ResetAction, Initiator, InitiatorIP,
          SigninIP = IPAddress, Country, City, Browser, OSPlatform,
          DeviceTrustType, Application, ClientAppUsed, UserAgent, RiskLevelDuringSignIn
| order by SigninTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackHours = 72h;
let ResetOps = dynamic([
    "Update user","Reset password (by admin)","Admin reset password",
    "Change user password","Reset user password","Set force change user password",
    "Update authentication phone","Update StrongAuthenticationUserDetails",
    "Disable Strong Authentication","User registered security info"
  ]);
let MfaReset = AuditLogs
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours)
  | where OperationName in~ (ResetOps)
  | extend InitiatorUpn = tolower(tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName))
  | extend InitiatorIp  = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress)
  | mv-expand TargetResources
  | extend TargetUpn = tolower(tostring(TargetResources.userPrincipalName))
  | where isnotempty(TargetUpn) and isnotempty(InitiatorUpn) and InitiatorUpn != TargetUpn
  | project ResetTime = TimeGenerated, InitiatorUpn, InitiatorIp, TargetUpn,
            ResetOperation = OperationName, AuditCorrelationId = CorrelationId;
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours)
| where ResultType == 0
| where IsInteractive == true
| extend TargetUpn   = tolower(UserPrincipalName)
| extend DeviceId    = tostring(DeviceDetail.deviceId)
| extend IsCompliant = tobool(DeviceDetail.isCompliant)
| extend Browser     = tostring(DeviceDetail.browser)
| extend DeviceOS    = tostring(DeviceDetail.operatingSystem)
| extend Country     = tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion)
| extend City        = tostring(LocationDetails.city)
| join kind=inner MfaReset on TargetUpn
| where TimeGenerated between (ResetTime .. ResetTime + 60m)
| where IPAddress != InitiatorIp
| where IsCompliant != true or isempty(DeviceId)    // attacker laptop = not Intune-compliant
| extend MinutesSinceReset = datetime_diff('minute', TimeGenerated, ResetTime)
| project ResetTime, SigninTime = TimeGenerated, MinutesSinceReset,
          TargetUpn, ResetOperation, InitiatorUpn, InitiatorIp,
          SigninIp = IPAddress, Country, City, Browser, DeviceOS,
          IsCompliant, DeviceId, AppDisplayName, UserAgent,
          RiskLevelDuringSignIn, RiskState, ConditionalAccessStatus
| order by SigninTime desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:azure.activeDirectory @evt.name:("Reset user password" OR "Reset password (by admin)" OR "Change user password" OR "Set force change user password" OR "Update authentication phone" OR "Update StrongAuthenticationUserDetails" OR "Disable Strong Authentication" OR "User registered security info" OR "Update user") -@user.userPrincipalName:@properties.targetResources.userPrincipalName

ucs.title: [LLM] Scattered Spider RMM-stacking persistence: ≥2 distinct remote-management tools deployed by the same account within 4 hours
ucs.description: Hunts the actor's signature persistence pattern of stacking multiple legitimate RMM agents (ScreenConnect/ConnectWise, AnyDesk, TeamViewer, Splashtop, ZohoAssist, Atera, Action1, Pulseway, FleetDeck, RustDesk, LogMeIn, Syncro) on the same victim under one user identity. Microsoft (Octo Tempest), Mandiant (UNC3944), and CISA AA23-320A all call out this multi-RMM stacking — a normal sysadmin uses one sanctioned tool; the actor stacks 2-4 to survive single-tool removal during incident response.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats `summariesonly`
    count,
    values(Processes.process_name) as rmm_processes,
    values(Processes.process) as cmdlines,
    values(Processes.dest) as hosts,
    values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parents,
    min(_time) as first_seen,
    max(_time) as last_seen,
    dc(Processes.process_name) as distinct_rmm
  from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
  where Processes.process_name IN (
    "ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe","ScreenConnect.WindowsClient.exe",
    "AnyDesk.exe","TeamViewer.exe","TeamViewer_Service.exe",
    "Splashtop-streamer.exe","SplashtopStreamer.exe",
    "ZohoAssist.exe","ZohoAssistClient.exe",
    "AteraAgent.exe","Action1Agent.exe","RustDesk.exe",
    "FleetDeck.exe","ConnectWise.exe","Syncro.exe",
    "Pulseway.exe","LogMeIn.exe","SRManager.exe","SRServer.exe"
  )
  by Processes.user, _time span=4h
| rename "Processes.user" as user
| where distinct_rmm>=2
| where NOT match(user, "\$$") AND user!="SYSTEM" AND user!="LOCAL SERVICE" AND user!="NETWORK SERVICE"
| eval window_minutes=round((last_seen-first_seen)/60, 1)
| table first_seen, last_seen, window_minutes, user, distinct_rmm, rmm_processes, hosts, parents, cmdlines
| sort 0 - first_seen
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let RmmBinaries = dynamic([
    "screenconnect.clientservice.exe","screenconnect.windowsclient.exe",
    "anydesk.exe","teamviewer.exe","teamviewer_service.exe",
    "splashtop-streamer.exe","splashtopstreamer.exe",
    "zohoassist.exe","zohoassistclient.exe",
    "ateraagent.exe","action1agent.exe","rustdesk.exe",
    "fleetdeck.exe","connectwise.exe","syncro.exe",
    "pulseway.exe","logmein.exe","srmanager.exe","srserver.exe"
  ]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| extend FileNameLower = tolower(FileName)
| where FileNameLower in (RmmBinaries)
   or FolderPath has_any ("ScreenConnect","ConnectWise Control","AnyDesk","TeamViewer","Splashtop","ZohoAssist","Atera Networks","Action1","RustDesk","FleetDeck","Pulseway","LogMeIn")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| summarize FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
            LastSeen  = max(Timestamp),
            DistinctRMM = dcount(FileNameLower),
            RmmList     = make_set(FileNameLower, 20),
            Hosts       = make_set(DeviceName, 20),
            Parents     = make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName, 20),
            SampleCmd   = any(ProcessCommandLine),
            SampleParentCmd = any(InitiatingProcessCommandLine)
            by AccountName, bin(Timestamp, 4h)
| where DistinctRMM >= 2     // 2 = empirical Scattered Spider floor; normal IT uses one sanctioned RMM
| extend WindowMinutes = datetime_diff('minute', LastSeen, FirstSeen)
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let RmmBinaries = dynamic([
    "screenconnect.clientservice.exe","screenconnect.windowsclient.exe",
    "anydesk.exe","teamviewer.exe","teamviewer_service.exe",
    "splashtop-streamer.exe","splashtopstreamer.exe",
    "zohoassist.exe","zohoassistclient.exe",
    "ateraagent.exe","action1agent.exe","rustdesk.exe",
    "fleetdeck.exe","connectwise.exe","syncro.exe",
    "pulseway.exe","logmein.exe","srmanager.exe","srserver.exe"
  ]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend NewProcessLeaf = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| where NewProcessLeaf in (RmmBinaries)
   or NewProcessName has_any ("ScreenConnect","ConnectWise Control","AnyDesk","TeamViewer","Splashtop","ZohoAssist","Atera Networks","Action1","RustDesk","FleetDeck","Pulseway","LogMeIn")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| where SubjectUserName !in~ ("SYSTEM","LOCAL SERVICE","NETWORK SERVICE")
| summarize FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
            LastSeen  = max(TimeGenerated),
            DistinctRMM = dcount(NewProcessLeaf),
            RmmList     = make_set(NewProcessLeaf, 20),
            Hosts       = make_set(Computer, 20),
            Parents     = make_set(ParentProcessName, 20),
            SampleCmd   = any(CommandLine)
            by SubjectUserName, bin(TimeGenerated, 4h)
| where DistinctRMM >= 2
| extend WindowMinutes = datetime_diff('minute', LastSeen, FirstSeen)
| order by FirstSeen desc

title: Scattered Spider / UNC3944 RMM Tool Execution
id: 8d1c4f70-7a2b-4f8e-9ad1-octotempestrmm01
status: experimental
description: Detects execution of remote-management tools associated with Scattered Spider / UNC3944 / Octo Tempest post-compromise persistence. A SIEM-side correlation must enforce the >=2 distinct RMM families per user / 4h window threshold; single-event firing is intended for ingestion into that aggregation.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa23-320a
  - https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2023/10/25/octo-tempest-crosses-boundaries-to-facilitate-extortion-encryption-and-destruction/
  - https://www.mandiant.com/resources/blog/unc3944-sms-phishing-sim-swapping-ransomware
author: Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/21
tags:
  - attack.persistence

  - attack.t1219.002

detection:
  selection_image:

      - '\ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe'

      - '\AnyDesk.exe'
      - '\TeamViewer.exe'
      - '\TeamViewer_Service.exe'
      - '\Splashtop-streamer.exe'
      - '\SplashtopStreamer.exe'

      - '\ConnectWise.exe'
